valueProp: One connected system for NDT and inspection companies: technician certifications, equipment calibration, crew dispatch, method-specific reports and invoicing, set up around the way your crews already work.

problems.label: Certification tracking
problems.problem: An expired certificate or eye test is found on site, or the day an auditor asks for it.
problems.solves: Every technician certificate is recorded by scheme, level and method, with status worked out automatically (active, expiring soon, expired). Warning tasks are raised 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid.

problems.label: Equipment calibration
problems.problem: Nobody is sure which flaw detector, probe or gauge is out of calibration until it is already on a job.
problems.solves: Each instrument is tracked by serial number with its calibration records, certificate, next due date and expiry alerts. Issue and return need approval, and crew planners are warned when assigned equipment is out of calibration.

problems.label: Inspection reporting
problems.problem: Reports are written on paper, typed up again in Word or Excel, and chased for signatures.
problems.solves: Method-specific NDT reports (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD and more) are captured in an offline field app, then move through draft, review, approval and sending with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures on versioned company templates.

problems.label: Scheduling and dispatch
problems.problem: Technicians and instruments get double-booked, and crews are assigned before anyone checks their certificates.
problems.solves: Jobs are dispatched as team assignments (planned, dispatched, in field, submitted, closed). Double-booking of technicians and of equipment serial numbers is blocked, leave feeds availability, and overlaps are refused.

problems.label: Audit preparation
problems.problem: Audit week means days of pulling certificates, calibration records and procedure revisions out of folders.
problems.solves: Procedures carry a controlled revision history with prepared, reviewed and approved sign-offs. Certificates, vision tests and calibration certificates sit in registers with status, and dashboards show what is expiring or overdue.

problems.label: A complete ERP
problems.problem: Quotes, jobs, timesheets and invoices live in separate tools that never quite agree with each other.
problems.solves: Every app is included and configured for NDT work: CRM and quotations, projects and crew dispatch, NDT reports, certificates and calibration, timesheets and invoicing, all on one platform.

assessment.intro: Five questions, about a minute. Your result appears straight away on this page; no email needed.

questions.q: How do you track technician certifications and eye tests today?
options: A spreadsheet or paper file that someone checks now and then
A shared tracker with reminders somebody sets by hand
A system that flags expiring certificates and vision tests automatically

questions.q: How do you know an instrument is in calibration before it goes to site?
options: We check the sticker or the certificate folder
A calibration list that is updated when someone remembers
Each serial number carries its due date and the system warns before issue

questions.q: How are inspection reports produced and approved?
options: Written on site, then retyped into Word or Excel
Templates filled in on a laptop, signatures chased by email
Captured in the field and reviewed and approved in one system

questions.q: How do you assign crews and equipment to jobs?
options: A shared calendar with no certificate check
A dispatch board that blocks double-booking and checks availability

questions.q: When a client or auditor asks for records, how long does it take to answer?
options: Days of digging through folders and inboxes
A few hours, if the right person is in
The records are already in one place and can be exported

bands.label: Paper and spreadsheets
bands.text: Most of your compliance lives in people's heads and folders. Start with the records auditors ask for first: certificates and calibration.

bands.label: Partly systemised
bands.text: Some records are organised, but they are not connected. Link certificates and calibration to dispatch so problems are caught before a crew leaves.

bands.label: Connected
bands.text: Your basics are in place. The gains now come from joining field reports, timesheets and invoicing so jobs close faster.

configurator.intro: Tell us how you work today, your biggest challenge, your crew size, the methods you run and the areas you want covered. You get a recommended starting point, a rollout order, migration notes for your current setup and an indicative timeline — before we ask for any contact details. No pricing; timelines are typical and confirmed during scoping.
configurator.timelineNote: Typical implementation is 2 to 4 weeks from kickoff; the exact plan is agreed during scoping and depends mostly on how clean your existing records are.

workflows.label: Paper forms and spreadsheets
workflows.note: Your technician list, certificates and equipment register are imported from the spreadsheets you already keep, so nobody retypes them. Paper report templates are rebuilt as digital report forms your technicians fill in on site.

workflow.text: An enquiry becomes a CRM opportunity and a quotation with job type, site, dates and applicable codes. Once the client accepts it online, it converts to a sales order and the job runs as a project.

workflow.step: Crew assignment with a certificate check
workflow.text: The job is dispatched to technicians who are available; double-booking of people and instrument serial numbers is blocked, and the planner is warned if assigned equipment is out of calibration. Timesheets warn if a technician's certificate is not valid.
The technician fills in a method-specific report in the offline field app, adds photos and signs on screen. It syncs when there is signal.
The report moves from draft to review to approved to sent, with reviewer and approver signatures, and is issued as a PDF on your company template.
Billable timesheet hours, equipment and consumables flow onto the invoice with method, technician and equipment serial on each line.

security.p: It runs as a cloud service, or it can be deployed on your own infrastructure where data-residency rules require it. The hosting location is agreed with you before go-live.
Reports and procedures record who prepared, reviewed and approved them, with signatures, and approved procedure revisions are locked with a full revision history.
The field app keeps drafts and photos on the device until it can sync, so a report is not lost when a site has no signal.
Your records can be exported, and access rights, backups and retention are set up with you during implementation and written into the rollout plan.

products.name: Digital Twin Reporting
products.standalone: A standalone Atlantis product that places inspection results on a 3D model of the asset.
products.asModule: Inside the ERP it works alongside the NDT Reports app, so approved reports can be shown on the asset model.

products.asModule: Inside the ERP, learners enrolled in the eLearning portal get a Practical NDT section that opens the platform.
